name: PrivateBin
description: PrivateBin is a minimalist, open source online pastebin where the server has zero knowledge of pasted data.
composeYaml:
services:
  privatebin:
    image: privatebin/nginx-fpm-alpine:latest
    environment:
    volumes:
      - 'privatebin_data:/srv/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10

meta.about: Minimalist pastebin/discussion board where the server has zero knowledge of hosted data.
